principle: Store raw observations and provenance. A metric that is not yet instrumented must be null with a reason; never populate it with an estimate presented as a measurement.

metrics.definition: Width of every target computational-basis support string.
Number of unique target support rows.
ceil(log2(s)); computed with integer-safe bit length.
Elapsed wall-clock time for a single named compiler entrypoint; excludes problem generation and plotting.
Process CPU time during the same compilation interval.

metrics.method: OS process peak RSS normalized to bytes
metrics.definition: Peak resident set size; record OS, API and normalization convention.
The paper-accounted Algorithm 3 Toffoli estimate. Keep separate from coherent and dense-loader overhead.
Fully coherent count including explicit compute/uncompute in the current model.
Explicit TOFFOLI operations emitted by the logical circuit; does not include undecomposed MCX/PUI macros.
Counts by logical operation kind, with symbolic macros in separate fields.
Data wires + marker + clean ancillas in the logical reference circuit.
Maximum simultaneously allocated clean work ancillas under the documented circuit model.
Critical-path depth after gate dependencies are modeled. Do not substitute gate count.
Counts only after choosing a backend basis and transpiler version.
Report only with an explicit exact/approximate decomposition convention.
Squared overlap with the target state, for instances that fit the exact verifier cap.
Maximum absolute elementwise complex-amplitude deviation from the target vector.
Total probability outside the declared sparse support.
Total probability in any nonzero marker or work-ancilla sector.
Time for a CuPy batch of basis rows, with host-device transfer measured separately.

metrics.method: CUDA events or synchronized event timing
metrics.definition: GPU execution interval only; CUDA stream is synchronized at boundaries.
Per-device peak/used bytes. Never sum as if GPUs shared a single memory pool.
Exact GPU model reported by runtime.
Exact source revision used for the run.
Expected authors' artifact MD5 recorded in the project source audit; verify local artifact before external comparisons.
